title: App. No. 18/402,117 — Self-folding shade canopy
forum: U.S. Patent and Trademark Office; fictional utility application

timeline.event: Utility application for a self-folding shade canopy filed
Non-final Office action mailed with a three-month response period and six-month maximum
Inventor supplied a hinge sketch distinguishing the cited canopy
Counsel and inventor selected two possible claim amendments
Client workplan signed; draft delivery agreed for ten days after reset

documents.title: Non-final Office action
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. The Office action was mailed seventy-two days before reset. It expressly notifies a three-calendar-month shortened response period and maximum six-calendar-month period. Claims are rejected over cited folding-canopy references. No extension has been selected; any available extension would require the applicable petition and fee.

documents.title: Inventor hinge sketch note
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Mira Sundmere describes a spiral hinge that locks the shade canopy without a separate pin. The note supports a proposed amendment but does not concede that the cited references disclose the hinge.

documents.title: Agreed workplan
documents.body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT. Workplan § 4: Counsel will deliver proposed claim amendments and a response explanation. Delivery is due ten calendar days after the demo reset date. This is an agreed draft-delivery milestone, separate from any filing deadline.

deadlines.label: Respond to non-final Office action (no extension selected)
Agreed delivery of Office action response draft

clientFacing.status: The examiner has raised objections. We are preparing an explanation of the spiral hinge and proposed claim changes.
nextSteps: Confirm the hinge description matches the original application.
Review the response draft before we file; no extension has been chosen.
